In 1888, the Governor General of Canada, The Lord Stanley of Preston, first attended the Montreal Winter Carnival tournament and was impressed with the game. His sons and his daughter, Isobel Stanley, were hockey enthusiasts.

question.hintNote: The McGill University Hockey Club, the first ice hockey club, was founded in 1877
